name: fawazahmed0/exchange-api (Open Source Currency API)
rate_limits: No rate limits. Served via jsDelivr CDN with Cloudflare Pages fallback.
notes: Completely free, open-source, no auth, no rate limits. 200+ currencies including fiat (ISO-4217), top 100 crypto, and precious metals (XAU, XAG). Historical data available via date-based npm package versioning. Fallback URL: https://latest.currency-api.pages.dev/v1/. Community-maintained so reliability depends on maintainer. Excellent for AI batch processing due to zero rate limits.
